title: Narsinh Mehta Lake, Junagadh - A Peaceful Retreat of Serenity and Devotion
content:
Narsinh Mehta Lake, Junagadh

Located in the heart of Junagadh, Gujarat, Narsinh Mehta Lake is a picturesque and tranquil spot that beautifully blends nature, spirituality, and history. Named after the revered saint-poet Narsinh Mehta, a devotee of Lord Krishna, this serene lake is one of the most popular attractions in Junagadh. Surrounded by lush greenery, walking paths, and scenic views of the Girnar Hills, it’s a perfect place to unwind, reflect, and reconnect with nature.

History & Significance

The lake is dedicated to Saint Narsinh Mehta, a 15th-century poet and saint whose bhajans and devotional songs are still cherished across Gujarat. It is believed that Narsinh Mehta often meditated and composed hymns near this lake, making it a sacred site for devotees and followers of Vaishnavism.

Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to visit Narsinh Mehta Lake is between October and February, when the weather is cool and pleasant. Early mornings and evenings are particularly delightful for a peaceful walk or a calm boat ride.

Timings & Entry Fee

  • Timings: 6:00 AM - 8:00 PM (Open every day)
  • Entry Fee: No entry fee (Boating charges may apply)

How to Reach

  • By Road: Located around 2 km from Junagadh city center; easily accessible by auto-rickshaw or taxi.
  • By Train: The nearest railway station is Junagadh Junction, about 3 km away.
  • By Air: The nearest airport is Rajkot Airport, approximately 100 km from Junagadh.

Things to Do at Narsinh Mehta Lake

  • Enjoy a leisurely stroll or morning jog around the lake.
  • Experience boating in the calm waters.
  • Capture the scenic beauty of sunset with Girnar Hills in the background.
  • Visit the nearby Narsinh Mehta Choro, a place associated with the saint’s life and bhajans.
